single_user_workflow.name: Single-User Workflow (Current)
single_user_workflow.description: Exclusive single-user access with request-response dialogs
table: User receives unique email link with auth credentials
System displays proof info and validates session
Check if proof is finalized, available, or in conflict
If proof is finalized, redirect to read-only mode
If no active session, grant immediate editor access
If session exists, activate request-response dialog
New user waits with timer, current user accepts/rejects
single_user_workflow.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Email Link] --> B[Landing Page]
    B --> C[Check Session]
    C -->|Finalized| D[Read-Only Mode]
    C -->|Available| E[Editor Access]
    C -->|Conflict| F[Dialog System]
    F --> G[Request Sender]
    F --> H[Request Receiver]
    H -->|Accept| I[Transfer Session]
    H -->|Reject| J[Wait Period]
    H -->|Timeout| I
    I --> E
    J --> K[Retry Later]

overall_flow.name: Overall Workflow
overall_flow.description: High-level overview of the entire workflow process
table: User accesses document via link and lands on page
System checks session and link validity
User is redirected to editor if access granted
User edits document with auto-save and idle handling
System manages access conflicts with dialogs and timeouts
User initiates finalization process with checks and save
overall_flow.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[User Access] --> B[Access Check]
    B --> C{Valid?}
    C -->|Yes| D[Editor Access]
    C -->|No| E[Show Error]
    D --> F[Editing Session]
    F --> G{Idle?}
    G -->|Yes| H[Idle Handling]
    G -->|No| F
    F --> I{Conflict?}
    I -->|Yes| J[Conflict Handling]
    I -->|No| F
    F --> K[Finalization]

main.name: Main
main.description: Primary end-to-end flow from landing page to finalization.
table: User opens the proofing or editor entry point
System checks URL, session, and role-specific permissions
User edits content with autosave and live checks
System manages session conflicts and request dialogs
System warns on inactivity and can close the session
User saves, validates, and completes the workflow
main.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Landing Page] --> B[Validate Access]
    B --> C{Allowed?}
    C -->|Yes| D[Editor Session]
    C -->|No| E[Show Error]
    D --> F{Conflict?}
    F -->|Yes| G[Conflict Handling]
    F -->|No| H[Idle Monitoring]
    G --> I[Resolve Request]
    H --> J{Idle?}
    J -->|Yes| K[Idle Handling]
    J -->|No| D
    K --> L[Finalization]

server_maintenance.name: ServerMaintenance
server_maintenance.description: Maintenance scheduling, database lookup, and runtime alert display flow.
table: Admin creates a maintenance record with start time, duration, end time, and reason
System stores the ServerMaintenance document with active status
Admin selects a duration in hours, defaulting to 2 hours
Client checks the database for the next active future maintenance window
MAINTENANCE.Init receives start and end timestamps
Landing page loads the maintenance toast when MAINTENANCE.Init({ init: true, fire: true }) runs
Logout confirmation injects the maintenance message through MAINTENANCE.fire({ returnText: true })
After the first auto-save, MAINTENANCE.fire({ stage: 'save' }) shows the maintenance alert
server_maintenance.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Admin schedules maintenance] --> B[Persist ServerMaintenance record]
    B --> C[Admin selects duration]
    C --> D[Compute end time]
    D --> E[server.js fetches active record]
    E --> F[Initialize MAINTENANCE runtime]
    F --> G{User path?}
    G -->|Landing Page| H[Landing page shows maintenance toast]
    H --> I[User dismisses alert]
    G -->|Editor Logout| J[Logout confirm includes maintenance message]
    J --> K[User confirms or cancels logout]
    G -->|Editor Auto Save| L[First auto-save shows maintenance alert]
    L --> M[User dismisses alert]

collaborative_module.name: Collaborative Module
collaborative_module.description: Socket-first lock and DB-first replacement collaboration workflow with local/UAT runtime switching, metadata-only notices, and doc-scoped socket rooms.
table: Choose collaborative or off only by explicit URL/localStorage; otherwise default legacy
In legacy/default, only paraLockSync starts; CollaborativeModule registers only after explicit collaborative opt-in
Only paraLockSync or CollaborativeModule actively processes lock/replacement writes
Local/UAT dialog is available only after explicit collaborative opt-in, then can switch runtime without page refresh
Legacy cursor movement uses lockid; collaborative cursor movement sends realtime lock/release notices
Replacement changes reuse a pending uniqueId and write authoritative updated_html rows before notices are sent
findupdatewithpush returns a small write acknowledgement; getFilterdocs owns lock/replacement hydration and lastSync filtering
BroadcastChannel collaborativeModule:<docid> and /collaboration?docid=<docid> send metadata only
Consumers fetch replacements by docid + uniqueId through getFilterdocs with filter; lock notices apply directly without get_lock_id
Active provider replacement apply stores response-received time as lastSync with lastSyncOnly and sends no notice
collaborative_module.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Resolve collaboration mode] --> B{Mode}
    B -->|legacy| C[Resume paraLockSync after FullyLoaded]
    B -->|collaborative| D[Start CollaborativeModule]
    B -->|off| E[Pause both and expose fallback]
    C --> F[Cursor sends DB lockid with stored lastSync]
    D --> G[Cursor sends realtime lock notice]
    D --> H[Replacement writes updated_html to DB]
    H --> I[findupdatewithpush returns ack only]
    I --> J[Notify uniqueId only]
    J --> K[Remote getFilterdocs by docid + uniqueId]
    K --> L[Capture response time and apply replacement]
    L --> M[Send flagUpdate]
    L --> N[Persist lastSyncOnly without notice]

table: Load parent role/config state for rendering decisions
Render query/comment block via common renderer
Render labels/status/actions based on role and state
Render attachment UI snippets and metadata
Return final HTML fragment/string to panel/dialog

flowchart TD
    A[Render Request] --> B[Set Parent Keys]
    B --> C[Resolve Role + Status]
    C --> D[Build Header]
    D --> E[Build Actions]
    E --> F[Build Body + Attachments]
    F --> G[Return HTML]

table: Validate email and sanitize HTML content

    B -->|ID| C[generateId]

query_system_bootstrap.name: Query System Bootstrap (Current)
query_system_bootstrap.description: DOMContentLoaded bootstrap waits for moduleRegistry/BaseModule, registers querySystem, binds window.queryModule, and supports Track View fallback.
table: Wait until moduleRegistry and BaseModule are available
moduleRegistry.getModule binds the singleton to window.queryModule
If Track View path is active, create QueryBaseModule directly
QueryBaseModule initializes its submodules and panel/dialog flows
query_system_bootstrap.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[DOMContentLoaded] --> B{moduleRegistry + BaseModule?}
    B -->|No| A
    B -->|Yes| C[registerDirectModule querySystem]
    C --> D[getModule querySystem]
    D --> E[window.queryModule]
    B -->|Track View| F[new QueryBaseModule]
    E --> G[Initialize Query Submodules]

landing_to_editor.name: Landing to Editor (Current LinkSession)
landing_to_editor.description: Landing access uses one common process=check workflow. The payload identity is the same, but DB lookup scope differs for collaborative and non-collaborative sessions.
table: Landing resolves the user email into USER_INFO.MAIL_ID before linksharing payload enrichment
LinkSessionCore.buildCheckPayload creates process=check with docid, session_id, and session_start_time
Linksharing payload enrichment supplies username, role, and rolename
postRequest adds collaborative: "1" only when collaborative mode is enabled
Backend routes to regular Linksharing or LinksharingCollaborative based on the collaborative flag
Non-collaborative check searches active sessions by docid only
Collaborative check searches active sessions by docid + rolename + username
No active matching row inserts or grants the session
Existing active same user/role/doc row denies access or stale-closes by backend last_saved_time rule
Collaborative different-user email is allowed because username is part of the lookup scope
Any active doc row in non-collaborative mode returns conflict or deny
landing_to_editor.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Email Verified] --> B[Build process check payload]
    B --> C[Add docid/session_id/session_start_time]
    C --> D[Add username/role/rolename]
    D --> E{Collaborative enabled?}
    E -->|No| F[Regular DB check by docid]
    E -->|Yes| G[Collaborative DB check by docid + rolename + username]
    F --> H{Active doc row?}
    H -->|No| I[Insert or grant session]
    H -->|Yes| J[Conflict or deny]
    G --> K{Active matching user row?}
    K -->|No| I
    K -->|Yes and stale| L[Backend stale-close by last_saved_time]
    K -->|Yes and active| J
    I --> M[completeAccessGrant and redirect]
    L --> M

editor_session_open.name: Editor Session Open (Current LinkSession)
editor_session_open.description: LinkSessionEditor installs session globals and CHECK_REQUEST; editor session checks and scheduler callbacks route through LinkSessionCore.
table: LinkSessionEditor.ensureGlobals creates singleton and installs LinkSession globals
newSessionCheck/openFromEditor posts process=check or refresh payloads
Editor ready/save validation uses getdocs verification to confirm the active session still matches local storage
startScheduler posts scheduled request checks while editing
Incoming requests open LinkSessionRequestDialog when available
editor_session_open.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[session_editor.js] --> B[LinkSessionEditor.ensureGlobals]
    B --> C[installSessionGlobals]
    C --> D[CHECK_REQUEST facade]
    D --> E[newSessionCheck / Scheduler]
    D --> F[getdocs session guard]
    F --> G{Valid active row?}
    G -->|Yes| H[Continue editor]
    G -->|No| I[Block stale session]

expired_session_guard.name: Expired Session Guard (Current)
expired_session_guard.description: Editor session guards block stale saves, stop timers, show expired_session_alert, and redirect through LinkSessionCore handlers.
table: Editor save or ready guard verifies the current session against the active DB row
LinkSessionCore guard logic detects stale, expired, or conflicting session reasons
STOP_ALL_EVENT_TIMERS runs when session is no longer valid
Session close/redirect globals move user back to a safe entry point
Request re-entry hooks are blocked after force-stop
expired_session_guard.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Editor Save or Scheduler] --> B[Session Response]
    B --> C{Valid Session?}
    C -->|Yes| D[Continue]
    C -->|No| E[STOP_ALL_EVENT_TIMERS]
    E --> F[expired_session_alert]
    F --> G[Redirect / Block Re-entry]

dialog_request_response.name: Request-Response Dialog System (Current)
dialog_request_response.description: Conflicts are coordinated by LinkSessionCore with landing send UI and editor request dialog modules.
table: Server check returns active-session conflict to landing user
LinkSessionSendModule.prompt starts send-request flow and waiting UI
Editor scheduler opens LinkSessionRequestDialog for current user
Accept/reject/timeout calls LinkSessionCore payload builders and updates session state
dialog_request_response.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
    participant NewUser
    participant Core as LinkSessionCore
    participant Send as LinkSessionSendModule
    participant Req as LinkSessionRequestDialog
    NewUser->>Core: accessFromLanding
    Core->>Send: prompt conflict
    Send->>Core: sendAccessRequest
    Core->>Req: open incoming request
    Req->>Core: accept/reject/timeout payload
    Core->>Send: poll result / grant / rejection

request_approval.name: Request Approval
request_approval.description: User requests access to locked document
table: User requests access to a locked document
System shows waiting dialog with timer
On approval, user is redirected to editor
request_approval.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Request Access] --> B[Send to Author]
    B --> C[System Waits 45s]
    C --> D[Check Status]
    D -->|Approved| E[Editor Access]
    D -->|Rejected| F[Show Rejection Reason]

session_workflow.name: Editor Session Workflow
session_workflow.description: Session handling for editor sessions including refresh, close/open, and logout scenarios
table: If browser refresh, detect existing tab_id
Request new session_id using tab_id + docid
Re-initialize session or block if invalid
Clear sessionStorage on close/open, require fresh validation
session_workflow.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Landing Page] --> B[Validate Access]
    B --> C{Valid?}
    C -->|Yes| D[Editor Session]
    D --> E{Refresh?}
    E -->|Yes| F[Detect tab_id]
    F --> G[Request new session_id]
    G --> H[Validate with DB]
    H --> I{Valid?}
    I -->|Yes| J[Re-init session]
    I -->|No| K[Block & Alert]
    E -->|No| L{Close/Open?}
    L -->|Yes| M[Clear sessionStorage]
    M --> N[Fresh Validation]
    L -->|No| O[Continue Editing]
    D --> P{Logout?}
    P -->|Yes| Q[Save & Logout]
    P -->|No| D

idle_session.name: Idle Session Handling
table: System detects user inactivity for 40 minutes
User confirms to continue or signs off
If no response, document is saved and session closed
idle_session.mermaid:
flowchart TD

    B -->|No| A
    B -->|Yes| C[Show Idle Alert]
    C --> D{User Response?}
    D -->|Continue| E[Save & Resume]
    D -->|Sign Off| F[Auto Save & Close]
    D -->|No Response| F

check_request.description: Periodic checking for new requests via scheduler
table: Check for new request status every 15s
Show dialog if new request detected

    B --> C[GET new_request_post]
    C --> D{Request Found?}
    D -->|Yes| E[Update Status]

save_flow.description: Document save and sync to server
table: User initiates save or auto-save triggered
Save request sent to server via AJAX
UI updates to show save status

cjk_mismatch_mail.name: CJK_MISMATCH Mail Trigger
cjk_mismatch_mail.description: Save-time East Asian character count validation, alert display, and one-time support mail trigger
table: SaveModule.save validates session, prepares editor data, and runs validateContent
contentValidator.validateDocumentContent compares original and editor East Asian character counts
When validation fails and ignore_cjk_alert is not true, SaveModule sets reason to CJK_MISMATCH
handleValidationFailure hides loading UI, detects collator role, and calls showDialogAlertwithMailSend
For collator users, mail is skipped and only the CHINESE_CHAR warning is shown
For non-collator users, triggerAutoMail calls SupportMailDialog.errorMailWithFallback
SupportMailDialog checks existing ErrorLogs and in-memory sent keys for CJK_MISMATCH
First occurrence sends genericsendemail and records the mail to ErrorLogs; repeated occurrences exit without triggering mail
Alert acknowledgement redirects the current session to read-only view
cjk_mismatch_mail.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[SaveModule.save] --> B[validateContent]
    B --> C[contentValidator.validateDocumentContent]
    C --> D{CJK counts match?}
    D -->|Yes| E[Continue save]
    D -->|No| F[reason = CJK_MISMATCH]
    F --> G[handleValidationFailure]
    G --> H{Collator role?}
    H -->|Yes| I[Skip mail]
    H -->|No| J[triggerAutoMail]
    J --> K[SupportMailDialog.errorMailWithFallback]
    K --> L{Existing ErrorLogs or sent key?}
    L -->|Yes| M[Exit without mail]
    L -->|No| N[genericsendemail]
    N --> O[Record ErrorLogs]
    I --> P[Show warning dialog]
    M --> P
    O --> P
    P --> Q[Redirect read-only]

current_guard_integration.name: ParaLock Guard Integration (Current)
current_guard_integration.description: Current code consumes window.paraLock as a global collaboration guard: modules check lock state before edits and pause/resume/send lock events through editor-level hooks.
table: window.paraLock is expected to provide _isEnabled, _isElementLocked, getLockedElementsByOthers, and related hooks
BaseModule blocks dialog actions when the current selection is locked by another user
Notes, figures, references, citations, tables, restore, finalize, and query modules check ParaLock before mutating content
QueryBaseModule calls _handleQueryCommentRelatedUpdates and checks locks before query operations
Editor page handlers pause/resume ParaLock and can send lock state to the server
When paraLock is unavailable or disabled, modules continue single-user behavior
current_guard_integration.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[User Action] --> B{window.paraLock enabled?}
    B -->|No| C[Continue Normal Action]
    B -->|Yes| D[Check Lock State]
    D -->|Locked By Other| E[Block + Alert]
    D -->|Available| F[Run Module Operation]
    F --> G[Optional ParaLock Update Hook]

paragraph_locking.name: Paragraph-Level Locking (Current Integration)
paragraph_locking.description: Current module code respects paragraph lock markers and ParaLock APIs; the lock owner service is external/global to these modules.
table: Selection/context handlers inspect the current CKEditor block or closest paragraph
_isElementLocked and closest .para-locked checks determine whether editing is blocked
Insert/edit/delete flows call ParaLock before mutating document structures
Existing .para-locked markers and lock metadata drive user-facing blocked state
Editor lifecycle can pause/resume ParaLock events during save/logout/session transitions
paragraph_locking.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Selection / Context Menu] --> B[Resolve Block]
    B --> C{Lock Available?}
    C -->|Locked| D[Block Operation]
    C -->|Available| E[Allow Edit]
    E --> F[Save / Session Lifecycle]
    F --> G[Pause Resume or Send ParaLock Event]

live_synchronization_proposed.name: Live Content Synchronization (SocketBridge Frontend Ready)
live_synchronization_proposed.description: Frontend SocketBridge now carries metadata-only replacement notices; durable content still persists through REST/API and receivers fetch by uniqueId.
table: paraLockSync detects changed paragraph content during existing save/update flow
Existing API/DB path stores replacement data first
SocketBridge publishes metadata-only replacement notice after successful persistence
Other sessions receive replacement notice through collaboration/paraLock routing
Receiver fetches authoritative replacement data by uniqueId
Existing replacement application logic updates the editor if valid
live_synchronization_proposed.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Paragraph changed] --> B[Persist replacement via API/DB]
    B --> C{Save success?}
    C -->|Yes| D[SocketBridge replacement notice]
    C -->|No| E[No socket success event]
    D --> F[Remote receives uniqueId]
    F --> G[Fetch replacement by uniqueId]
    G --> H[Apply existing replacement logic]

socket_bridge_lifecycle.name: SocketBridge Document-Session Lifecycle
socket_bridge_lifecycle.description: One document session creates one SocketBridge connection; channel, scope, and type route feature messages without creating channel-specific sockets.
table: Feature module calls SocketBridge.getInstance with docid, source, user, role, and sessionId
Bridge is reused by docid plus sessionId; channel and scope are message routing fields
Feature handlers register by channel, scope, and type, with legacy string subscriptions still supported
Messages carry version, messageId, optional correlationId, docid, channel, scope, type, source, user, role, sessionId, timestamp, and payload
Module close unsubscribes handlers and disconnects when appropriate
socket_bridge_lifecycle.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Feature requests SocketBridge] --> B[Resolve docid + sessionId instance]
    B --> C{Existing bridge?}
    C -->|Yes| D[Reuse connection]
    C -->|No| E[Create bridge]
    E --> F[Connect to /collaboration?docid&source]
    D --> G[Subscribe by channel/scope/type]
    F --> G
    G --> H[Publish or receive messages]
    H --> I[Route to matching handlers]
    I --> J[Unsubscribe / disconnect]

parallocksync_socket_primary.name: ParaLock Socket-Primary With Fallback
parallocksync_socket_primary.description: paraLockSync uses SocketBridge while connected and keeps legacy REST/DB polling as fallback when realtime transport is unavailable.
table: paraLockSync loads SocketBridge with channel collaboration, scope paraLock, source editor
Connected bridge publishes LOCK_GET_STATE; REST/DB remains recovery source
Cursor movement publishes LOCK_ACQUIRE when socket is connected
LOCK_GRANTED, LOCK_DENIED, LOCK_RENEWED, LOCK_RELEASED, and LOCK_STATE route into existing lock UI handlers
Legacy interval remains alive but skips REST polling while SocketBridge is connected
When socket is unavailable, _runLockOnlyTick uses the existing REST/DB lock path
Successful replacement persistence sends metadata-only notice; remote side fetches by uniqueId
parallocksync_socket_primary.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[paraLockSync runtime] --> B[Connect SocketBridge]
    B --> C[Subscribe paraLock messages]
    C --> D{Socket connected?}
    D -->|Yes| E[Publish LOCK_GET_STATE / LOCK_ACQUIRE / LOCK_RELEASE]
    E --> F[Receive LOCK_* notice]
    F --> G[Apply existing lock UI]
    D -->|No| H[Fallback REST/DB lock polling]
    H --> G
    E --> I[Replacement notice metadata only]
    I --> J[Remote fetches by uniqueId]

landing_presence.name: Landing Page Presence
landing_presence.description: Landing Page announces early collaborative presence through SocketBridge and falls back to compatibility transport if the bridge asset is unavailable.
table: LandingPage loads socket_bridge asset when collaborative mode is active
Creates document-session bridge with channel presence, scope document, source landing
Publishes presence join for active document users
If bridge cannot load, fallback uses /collaboration?docid=<docid>&source=landing
Editor may ingest early presence through existing local state
landing_presence.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
    participant Landing
    participant Bridge as SocketBridge
    participant Server as /collaboration
    participant Editor
    Landing->>Bridge: getInstance docid source landing
    Landing->>Bridge: presence join
    Bridge->>Server: channel presence scope document
    Server-->>Editor: route to active document sessions
    Editor->>Editor: ingest/display presence when available
